text.p: Former England international Chris Waddle who played seven matches for his boyhood idols Sunderland at the end of the season, has left the club, manager Peter Reid said on Tuesday.
Reid praised Waddle's contribution during his brief stay at the club, but said he would not be renewing the 36-year-old's contract which runs out at the end of June.
Waddle played seven times for Sunderland, scoring one goal, but could not prevent them slipping out of the premier league on the last day of the season.
Waddle, whose previous clubs include Newcastle, Tottenham, Marseille, Sheffield Wednesday and Bradford City, intends to continue playing for the forseeable future.
